use default
use Raster.IMAGE

use POINT = (x: double, y: double)

midpoint(a: POINT, b: POINT) -> POINT =>
    (x = (a.x + b.x) / 2.0, y = (a.y + b.y) / 2.0)

triangle(a: POINT, b: POINT, c: POINT) -> List[POINT] =>
    [a, b, c]

let image = IMAGE(512, 456)

image.view(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0.89)
image.colour(30ub, 90ub, 160ub)

draw(a: POINT, b: POINT, c: POINT, order: int) is
    if order == 0 then
        image.fill(triangle(a, b, c))
        return
    fi

    draw(a, midpoint(a, b), midpoint(a, c), order - 1)
    draw(midpoint(a, b), b, midpoint(b, c), order - 1)
    draw(midpoint(a, c), midpoint(b, c), c, order - 1)
si

draw(
    (x = 0.5, y = 0.87),
    (x = 0.0, y = 0.01),
    (x = 1.0, y = 0.01),
    6
)

image.write("sierpinski.png")

image.show("sierpinski.png")
